notes.title: Another new gameplay again
notes.notes:
Almost a year after the release of the EA version, I completed almost everything in the game. The game is now ready for official release.
In the next few days, if there are no bigproblems with the test, it will be officially released.
In addition, the name of the game was changed from "Starship Helmet" to "Folding Edge".
The game's Gameplay has been completely modified. You can play as a new game.
*************************************************************************************************
[h2]Some Word[/h2]
	This game was developed full-time by Xiaoming solo for 1.5 years.
	After almost a year of testing and modification of the EA version, because of various dissatisfaction, it was almost remaked by 3 times.
	In any case, the quality of this game finally met my expectations.
	When the game was finally released, Xiao Ming's eyes were wet.
	I paid a lot and finally insisted.
	At this moment,Success or failure of the game are not so important.
	Thank gays who supporting and helping me in the EA Vesion. Many of them left comments in EA reviews.
	Best regards to you all.

notes.title: EA 0.5.0 Version Released -- almost a new GamePlay
notes.notes:
Sorry, the new version was originally expected to be released in late July.
However, I temporarily decided to modify the game to change the map to a hex random space (dungeon?), after nearly 2 months of overtime efforts. I almost rebuild this game. And  the new version was finally released.
The new version includes
[list]
[*] The new rogue-like map form (hexagonal space dungeon)
[*] The new character Space Tongue Monster.
[*] Cards can summon mercenaries (mercenary system)
[/list]

I am very happy to post this change.
The current game is still fun even after I have played at least 2,000 times in develop.This is the magic power of rogue like.
Thank you for your support and I highly recommend everyone to experience it again.

notes.title: The new character Space Tongue Beast is comming in a week
notes.notes:
The new character Space Tongue Beast is expected to be released in a week.
There were some accidents in the family in June. The earthquake in my hometown leaded to delay in development.
The new version includes
1. The new character Space Tongue  Beast with 50 new cards.
2. Mercenary system.
3. Some bug fixes.
Thank you for your support! Dam

notes.title: 星舰头盔EA 0.3.0版本发布
notes.notes:
版本包括以下内容
1.三个关卡的内容
2.加入难度系统
3.新增角色系统(目前只有一个头盔[无用之用]可以选择
4.优化UI
5.修改若干bug


这个版本内容较多我预估的开发时间是3-4周，实际要比预估多花2周。
目前这个版本战斗系统和杀戮尖塔比较像。
下个版本计划加入舰队系统，卡牌绑定行动的飞船。飞船可以自由的雇佣和解散。
预计2-3周修改完毕。

最后感谢各位玩家大人的支持，虽然现在购买的人不多几十个。但是你们的留言和反馈是我最大的动力。

notes.title: 我在憋一一个大的版本，预计在1周之内发布。
notes.notes:
各位玩家大人，这次版本间隔比较长。四月生了一次病发了3天的烧，自从做独立游戏以来身体是越来越差了。
下一步版本会有以下内容
1.三个关卡
2,次时代的星舰头盔造型
3,j20为原型的boss
4.角色界面

修改若干内容。
发布至今很多玩家都提出了非常牛逼的建议。
我几乎会采纳所有。
特别是 让游戏更加星际探索一些，剔除一些杀戮尖塔的影子。

感谢大家的支持。。。
已购买的玩家大人 不用担心 这个游戏不会太监的……

notes.title: 星舰头盔EA 0.2.0版本发布
notes.notes:
星舰头盔EA 0.2.0版本修改以下内容
1.修改随机装备生成系统,剔除掉95%的无厘头生成。
2.右下角增加关卡信息，以及快速定位到飞船。
3.卡牌增加炮击,导弹，能量武器，技能，诅咒类型。
4.每使用能量武器,手牌中的能量武器消耗-1。
5.修正战斗机和轰炸机鼠标指向判断过小。
6.修正获得卡牌显示与实际获得显示不一致。
7.装备生成系统允许添加buff
8.装备生成系统增加权值。效果越好的概率越小。
9.修正干扰弹消耗7枚导弹为1枚导弹。
10.特效光污的问题。目前暂时关掉了所有战斗中的背景特效。
11.修正全效防御卡牌显示能量值的问题。

总结:本次修改主要修改了装备系统，以及卡牌不合理的数值。游戏难度应该有提高。
